label: GO step early in the episode, biased toward choosing a1
explanation: Fires only at the GO step (never at D1 or D2). It is an episode-time feature: it is active on every GO step for episode trials 0-9, and its rate falls steadily (0.26 at trials 0-9, 0.08 at 40-49, about 0 after trial 60). In the middle of the episode it mostly fires when the agent is choosing a1 (a1 rate 0.12 vs a2 0.04; model_act==1 rate 0.36; mass is concentrated where the choice logit is strongly for a1), and more often in episodes where S1 starts out good. action at GO is the agent's own upcoming choice, which is legitimate; the model_act==1 version scores the same (F1 0.745). It is not modulated by previous reward, transition type, or stay/switch. Dev F1 0.75, mass recall 0.86. Misses are a2 GO steps early in low_first episodes. False positives are a1 GO steps at trials 10-50 where it is silent. A plain GO & ep_trial<50 predicate has recall 0.97 but precision 0.46.
